_comment: Arabic edition. Fixed Arabic spellings of names (so the AI translator writes a name the same way in every line) and a short note about each game's tone. 'match': any of these inside the game's title selects the entry (case is ignored). The user can add or override entries in %LOCALAPPDATA%\GameTranslator\glossary-ar.json with the same shape.

games.notes: Open-world crime story set in a fictional state modelled on Florida. Characters speak casual street slang with sarcasm, threats and insults; keep that tone, short and sharp, and never make the lines formal.
Open-world crime satire set in a fictional California. Characters speak casual street slang with sarcasm, threats and insults; keep that tone, short and sharp, and never make the lines formal.
